altitude.summary: The tell of the two calls is altitude, not warmth. Robin flexes between two heights fluently, but he only flexes UP after the ground floor is nailed. Call 1 stayed at his resonant altitude (felt pain + one narrow idea). Call 2 launched straight to maximum altitude (universal physics, org-wide platform, IPO governance) before the wedge existed, and he could not feel it or retell it, so he left.

ladder.whatHeDoes: Leans in, finishes your sentences, names the pain back to you, coaches
ladder.trigger: A single narrow idea tied to a real person’s pain (his own LinkedIn/job-fit story)

ladder.whatHeDoes: Reframes it as a category or movement, connects to market comps and his own portfolio
ladder.trigger: Once the wedge is obvious, he elevates it to “why this matters”

ladder.whatHeDoes: Goes philosophical: roadmap for life, human-first, purpose
ladder.trigger: Trust + a landed idea; he ascends to meaning, never opens there with a pitch

ladder.whatHeDoes: Disengages: one-word replies, checks the clock, exits
ladder.trigger: Physics, jargon, everything-platform framing before a concrete wedge, exactly Call 2

lands: One narrow use case, named as a wedge (“we do X for Y”), not a platform that does everything
A felt, personal-pain story, ideally his own (LinkedIn can’t match me; I didn’t want to be just the CMO)
“Movement / category” framing over feature or mechanism framing
Concrete market proof (Gloat, Eightfold, Beamery, Gartner numbers), he lives in this category
Being asked a sharpening question, then given a crisp answer (“is it a platform or an algorithm?”, answer it in one line)
loses: Physics / entropy / “coherence engine” abstraction with no product on the other end
Everything-platform sprawl across marketing + hiring + ad-tech + M&A in one breath
An ask to be an internal champion before there is a single, dead-simple thing to champion
Long monologue / screen-share with little back-and-forth (he is a dialogue thinker)
Jargon that cannot be retold in a sentence to a cross-functional stakeholder
